description: This file declares various functions and templates for reading from and writing to file descriptors, specifically for shared file descriptors (SharedFD). It provides functions for reading exact amounts of data, reading binary data, writing data, and sending/receiving data over sockets, aimed at buffer management and I/O operations.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads from a SharedFD until the fd is closed or an error occurs; stores data in a string.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads exactly buf->size() bytes from a SharedFD into a string or vector, or until an error occurs.

methods.name: ssize_t ReadExactBinary(SharedFD fd,T * binary_data)
methods.description: Template function that reads a binary value of type T exactly from a SharedFD.

methods.name: WriteAll
methods.description: Writes the entire contents of a string or vector to a SharedFD, ensuring complete transmission.

methods.name: ssize_t WriteAllBinary(SharedFD fd,const T * binary_data)
methods.description: Template function that writes a binary value of type T to a SharedFD.

methods.name: SendAll
methods.description: Sends the contents of a string view over a socket with error checking.

methods.name: RecvAll
methods.description: Receives a specified number of bytes from a socket, returning the data as a string.
